content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I was considering updating my controller to [version_no] in order to use MQTT features. I already have a local MQTT broker set up. Are there any useful guides or sample projects demonstrating how to set the controller as a client and how to subscribe or publish to topics? Thanks, [user_name]
The [product_name] [version_no] does not have native support for MQTT. It only supports S7 and Modbus connections.
Not directly, but MQTT integration is possible through platforms like Node-RED or IOBroker.

analysis.insight_summary: Users initially thought the [product_name] [version_no] would offer built-in MQTT client functionality, but discovered through discussion that native MQTT support is missing. Some users explored using third-party solutions as intermediaries to enable MQTT connectivity.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects [product_name] [version_no] to have out-of-the-box MQTT support for straightforward subscription and publishing to MQTT topics.
